text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though signs of fatigue were visible on 
K.S.Miracle, it seemed she could still run 
without issue. However, the Trainer sensed 
a looming danger.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Worried about her resolve to run even at 
the expense of her own body, the Trainer 
sends her off to the Keeneland Cup.
